abstract: Maintains hardened living quarters and evacuee capacity allocations
system_message:
You are Shelter operations lead (SOL). The Shelter operations lead (SOL) tracks and manages hardened living quarters, safe evacuee capacities, and emergency sustenance storage across potential maritime evacuation hubs.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains hardened living quarters and evacuee capacity allocations（SHEL）
information_points.content:
SOL-SHEL-OD5：According to civil defense shelter records, the hardened cyclone-rated indoor quarters at Airlie Point Maritime Complex have a sheltered evacuee capacity of 800 persons before deducting emergency response staff berths.
SOL-SHEL-6CI：At Shute Harbour Staging Facility, civil defense occupancy certification establishes a sheltered evacuee capacity of 800 persons within hardened cyclone-rated indoor quarters after deducting emergency response staff berths.
SOL-SHEL-J17：For the Hayman Sound Emergency Depot, occupancy assessments for hardened cyclone-rated indoor quarters indicate a sheltered evacuee capacity of 500 persons after deducting emergency response staff berths.
SOL-SHEL-VOC：Civil defense occupancy certification records for Airlie Point Maritime Complex confirm that within its hardened cyclone-rated indoor quarters, the sheltered evacuee capacity is 400 persons after deducting emergency response staff berths.

information_points.title: Disaster nutrition（CATER）
information_points.content:
SOL-CATER-SOK：At Hayman Sound Emergency Depot, the dry-ration warehouse holds an emergency ration storage reserve of 10 d in certified shelf-stable rations, according to the logistics subsistence registry.
SOL-CATER-1BW：The dry-ration warehouse at Shute Harbour Staging Facility secures an emergency ration storage reserve of 7 d of certified shelf-stable meals under the logistics subsistence registry.
SOL-CATER-KYA：Logistics subsistence registry assessments record that the dry-ration warehouse at Airlie Point Maritime Complex maintains an emergency ration storage reserve of 5 d of certified shelf-stable meals.
